# Scaling Multi-Tower Operations

Date: 2023-02-06  
Attendees: Ysolde Fennford, Fiora Velkbrook, Linnea Marqmoor  

**Agenda:**  
- Review infrastructure upgrades for scaling from 10 to 25 grow towers  
- Assess nutrient dosing system capacity and automation needs  
- Update on yield forecasting model integration  

**Discussion:**  
Ysolde opened with the goal to triple production capacity by Q3 2023, requiring upgrades to climate control and nutrient delivery systems. Fiora reported current nutrient dosing pumps handle up to 500 liters/hour, but scaling will require at least doubling to 1,200 liters/hour to serve 25 towers. Linnea presented preliminary yield forecast models showing a 15% variance margin, aiming to improve accuracy by integrating real-time sensor data from new towers. The team debated phased rollout versus all upgrades at once; phased approach preferred to limit downtime.  

**Decisions:**  
- Proceed with phased infrastructure upgrades starting March 2023  
- Upgrade dosing pumps to 1,200 liters/hour capacity by May  
- Integrate enhanced forecasting sensors in new towers only for pilot  

**Action Items:**  
- Fiora to finalize pump specs and vendor quotes by 02/20 (Owner: Fiora Velkbrook)  
- Linnea to develop sensor integration plan and timeline by 02/25 (Owner: Linnea Marqmoor)  
- Ysolde to coordinate with operations for phased rollout schedule by 02/28 (Owner: Ysolde Fennford)
